# three.js animatic: 3D camera blocking for a storyboard, rendered to MP4

**A shot list becomes a three.js grey-box with mannequins, real lenses and a camera plan, rendered to MP4 for Seedance @video1.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_5d51f752766a.webp" alt="A coded blockout animatic of a starship racing down a red tunnel plays beside the Seedance video made from it." width="480"></p>

Build a three.js animatic ("animatronic", 3D previz, blockout) of a multi-shot video: every storyboard shot becomes a schematic 3D scene drawn in code, with jointed mannequins and poses, master sets in real metres and props, a real camera per shot (START/END keys, lens in mm, move and ease), timed to the music or voiceover, reviewed in the browser with a top-down set map of every camera frustum, approved, exported as a camera plan, rendered to MP4 frame by frame (headless Chrome or HyperFrames), then used as the @video1 reference for Seedance 2.5 video-to-video on varg so the generated shots keep the approved camera and blocking. Use when someone asks for a three.js animatic or animatronic, a 3D previz or blockout, camera blocking, a camera plan, shot sizes and lenses, a grey-box of a storyboard, previz to Seedance, a reference video for video-to-video, or a look blockout (reference pictures as textures on the blockout, stills for look approval). Includes a working starter project (no npm).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill threejs-animatic                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills threejs-animatic --agent github-copilot --scope user

```
